title: Gaussian comparison above the median
summary: We prove a Gaussian comparison inequality for closed convex sets with reference probability at least 1/2. For centered Gaussian vectors whose covariance matrices are ordered in the Loewner sense, the smaller covariance law assigns at least as much probability as the larger covariance law to every closed convex set with measure at least 1/2 under the larger covariance. More generally, we show that convolving a nondegenerate Gaussian law with any independent centrally symmetric distribution cannot increase the probability of a closed convex set when the convolved probability is at least 1/2.…
